website_summary.name: Stock Report Generator
website_summary.description: The website displays dynamic stock information and offers analytical tools with a clean, professional design.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clear and organized layout with distinct sections. It features a navigation header with "Stock Report Generator" prominently displayed. Below this, there's a section for stock information which includes a live price update, volume, and market cap. The "Historical Data" section showcases price and volume over time with a line graph. Additionally, the "Financial Metrics" and "Financial Summary" tables present key financial indicators and revenue details in a tabular format. The "Ownership Distribution" offers a pie chart for visualizing investor distribution, while the "Stock Performance" shows a line graph of price trends. The footer includes a customizable report section with checkboxes for content selection (e.g., Overview, Financials) and a "Download Report" button. The background is white, and various components utilize navy blue for text and buttons, ensuring a consistent color scheme and modern appearance.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to generate customized stock reports. By selecting a company (default is "Apple Inc."), users can filter search and view detailed information such as stock prices, changes in price, volume, market cap, and financial data. The site includes interactive features like hovering over data points on graphs for more detailed information. Users can also customize report content by selecting options like "Overview" and "Financials," followed by downloading the generated report. This makes it easy to tailor the report to specific needs.

functionality_testing.name: Download Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Download Button triggers the report download process, providing complete standardized or customized report data.

functionality_testing.expected_results: The downloading process visually starts, leading to successfully downloading a report file reflecting data on the UI.
